title: Square-to-round transition
description: A four-piece transition from a 400 x 300 mm rectangular duct to a 250 mm round duct in 0.8 mm galvanised steel: flat triangles and developable cone corners with straight ends, one piece unfolded into the flat pattern cut four times, with a lapped collar, a P20 angle frame and a sealed spigot.
process: Laser or plasma cut blanks, press-brake bump forming, four pieces seamed; galvanised steel

difficulty.rationale: A developable sheet plus a ruled loft proven to be the same surface, a flapped unfold, quadrature and Steiner proofs, and five kernel limits worked around.

prompt_test.model: Claude Sonnet 5.5, medium effort, through craft3d-cli
prompt_test.result: Passed: document.check ok with its own 26 assertions; flat pattern 58 832.87 mm2, piece 43 072.29 mm3, spigot 248.90 mm and length 300.000 mm equal to this example's; steel parts 2.737 kg (+0.6 %); 202 steps, about 230 commands. It measured the pattern's clearance by its box, since clearance and distance refuse sheets (F-105), and needed tolerance 1e-5 for the plate.
